claims.skill_quote: Parse `$ARGUMENTS` for an optional window (`24h`, `14d`, `30d`) or `compare` (default: last 7 days).
claims.reasoning: The command only defines the window-argument slot, its accepted formats, and its default; it has no way to know how many days any particular milestone actually spanned. Instructing the operator to compute the milestone's real length and substitute it as <Nd> is a per-invocation parameter, not a restatement of methodology, so this is load-bearing rather than duplication.

claims.kickoff_quote: **Retro — set the window to the milestone.** Bare, this command retrospects the last 7 days, so a milestone that ran longer gets a retro covering only its final week.
